name: Risky SQL migrations (Squawk)
description: Finds migrations that lock tables or break running queries.

run.cmd: : > "$TMPDIR/squawk.txt"; s=0; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name '*.sql' -path '*migrat*' -print > "$TMPDIR/sql.txt" || s=2; while IFS= read -r f; do squawk --reporter gcc "$f" > "$TMPDIR/one.txt"; c=$?; cat "$TMPDIR/one.txt" >> "$TMPDIR/squawk.txt"; [ $c -eq 0 ] || { [ $c -eq 1 ] && [ -s "$TMPDIR/one.txt" ]; } || s=2; done < "$TMPDIR/sql.txt"; awk -F: 'BEGIN{OFS=":"} NF>=4 {$2=$2+1} {print}' "$TMPDIR/squawk.txt"; exit $s
